summary: American Electric Power Company (AEP) disclosed entry into forward sale agreements covering 23,543,308 shares of its common stock, at an initial forward sale price of $124.968 per share, in conjunction with an underwritten public offering. The forward purchasers are Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley. AEP expects to physically settle on or before May 31, 2028, receiving net proceeds at that time. The transaction functions as an equity forward, allowing AEP to lock in current pricing while deferring share issuance. This is a capital return mechanism for the issuer. The key watchpoint is AEP's discretion on settlement timing; early settlement may indicate near-term capital need.
